title: Google Play Developer Lead Scraper Input
description: Search Google Play and extract developer leads. Pay per lead.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to pull apps for (e.g. invoicing, crm, meditation). Each term is one Play search.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Play category IDs to pull top apps from (e.g. BUSINESS, PRODUCTIVITY, FINANCE, HEALTH_AND_FITNESS). Optional, used alongside keywords.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code for the store (gl). Default us.

collection.title: Category collection
collection.description: Which chart to pull for each category. TOP_FREE is the broadest.

expandSimilar.title: Expand with similar apps
expandSimilar.description: Widen the net by also pulling apps similar to the first seeds found. Increases volume and diversity.

maxApps.title: Max apps
maxApps.description: Cap total apps scraped per run across all queries.

maxAppsPerQuery.title: Max apps per query
maxAppsPerQuery.description: Cap apps taken from each keyword or category.

requireEmail.title: Only apps with a developer email
requireEmail.description: Skip apps that do not publish a developer contact email.

minInstalls.title: Minimum installs
minInstalls.description: Drop apps below this install count. Zero keeps every app.

qualifiedMinInstalls.title: Qualified install bar
qualifiedMinInstalls.description: Installs at or above this, with an email and website, tier a lead as qualified_lead.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Recommended at volume so Play does not rate limit a single IP.
